messages.content:
Triage this support ticket.

Subject: 2FA not working after enabling it on our account
Body: We enabled two-factor authentication last week for our 12 seats and now half our team can't log in at all, they're getting an error that says 'authentication code invalid' even when they use the correct code from Google Authenticator, but if we disable 2FA everyone can get back in fine. This is broken since it's supposed to work according to your docs, so we'd like a credit on our invoice for the past week since people couldn't actually use the product properly. Can you either fix this or let us know what's going on.

Which team should own it?
- "billing": Invoices, charges, refunds, payment methods, or subscription cost.
- "technical": Bugs, outages, errors, broken integrations, or the product not working as documented.
- "account": Login, passwords, permissions, roles, seats, or profile and workspace settings.
- "sales": Pricing questions, plan upgrades, trials, quotes, or buying more seats.

How urgent is it?
- 0: Can wait until next week. Nothing is blocked.
- 1: Should be handled today, but the customer can still work.
- 2: The customer is blocked right now and cannot do their job.
- 3: Money is actively being lost or data is at risk. Minutes matter.

refund_requested: They ask for a refund, a credit, or their money back. (false: They only report a problem, ask a question, or complain.)
angry: Hostile, sarcastic, shouting, threatening to leave, or openly furious. (false: Calm and matter-of-fact, even when reporting a serious problem.)

Answer with JSON only.

tickets.subject: 2FA not working after enabling it on our account
tickets.body: We enabled two-factor authentication last week for our 12 seats and now half our team can't log in at all, they're getting an error that says 'authentication code invalid' even when they use the correct code from Google Authenticator, but if we disable 2FA everyone can get back in fine. This is broken since it's supposed to work according to your docs, so we'd like a credit on our invoice for the past week since people couldn't actually use the product properly. Can you either fix this or let us know what's going on.

tickets.subject: Custom fields disappearing from task view after sync with Jira
tickets.body: We have 12 seats and yesterday afternoon after the Jira integration sync our custom fields that we mapped (Priority Level, Cost Center, Client ID) stopped appearing in the task detail panel even though they're still showing up in the raw data when I export to CSV, but our team can't actually see them when working on tasks which is breaking our workflow since we need those fields to assign work. It was working fine before the sync and I've already tried logging out and clearing cache but the fields just won't render. Can you look into why the custom field display broke after that integration?

tickets.subject: Slack integration not syncing task updates
tickets.body: Hi, we've had the Slack integration connected for a couple weeks now and it was working fine at first but starting yesterday afternoon the task updates stopped showing up in our #projects channel. We're on the 15-seat plan and I've checked that the integration is still authorized in our workspace settings, the channel permissions look right, and tasks are definitely being updated in the app itself - they're just not making it to Slack anymore. Can you take a look at what might be going on on your end? Let me know if you need any logs or screenshots.

tickets.subject: Question about our monthly subscription charges
tickets.body: Hi, I've been reviewing our invoices for the last few months and I noticed our bill keeps going up even though we're not adding new seats. We've had the same 12 people on the account since January but last month jumped to $612 and this month is $637, both on the 1st. Can someone explain whats happening with our recurring charges, I want to make sure we're not being double-billed or something. Thanks.

tickets.subject: BROKEN custom fields - losing data AGAIN and need credit on our account
tickets.body: This is ridiculous, we've been paying $49/seat for 8 months now and the custom fields feature keeps corrupting our project data. We set up custom dropdown fields last week and half our tasks lost the values we entered, then when we tried to recreate them the fields just disappeared entirely from the board view even though they show up in settings. This is costing us real money because our team has to manually re-enter everything and we're way behind schedule. We want a credit applied to our next invoice for at least the last month since your product clearly isn't working as you documented it would. This should have been tested before release.

tickets.subject: need to add 3 more seats before end of day - slack integration sync issue eating into our trial
tickets.body: Hi we're on day 8 of our 14 day trial and just realized our slack integration isn't syncing task updates properly which means our team has been missing critical project deadlines, we need to upgrade to 8 seats immediately to get the premium slack features and I need to know if we can do this today since we're deciding between your tool and monday.com by tomorrow morning, also if we upgrade now do we get prorated pricing for the rest of this month or do we pay full price

tickets.subject: we need more seats urgently - sprint reports showing we're over capacity
tickets.body: Hi, we just ran our sprint report and realized we have 47 active users but only 40 seats allocated, so some of our devs can't even access their tasks mid-sprint and we're losing time trying to work around this. Can you tell me how much it would cost to upgrade to 60 seats and if we can do it today so people can get back to work? This is killing our velocity on a client project. Our current invoice is from last month under order #TW-89234.

tickets.subject: Webhook not firing for invoice.payment_failed events
tickets.body: Hi, we've got 15 seats on the annual plan and our accounting system relies on the webhook to catch failed payment notifications so we can flag accounts internally, but we're not receiving any of the invoice.payment_failed events even though we know payments are failing on our end. Can you check if webhooks are actually being sent for billing events or if there's something we need to configure differently on our account?

tickets.subject: Search function broken - affecting billing audit
tickets.body: Hi, we're trying to search through our invoice history to reconcile charges from last quarter but the search feature in the Billing section keeps returning no results even when we search for specific invoice numbers that we know exist. This is making it impossible to verify if we're being charged correctly for our 23 seats, we have multiple invoices dating back 6 months that should show up but they're completely invisible in the system right now. Can someone look into this immediately because we need to close our books today and I can't proceed without seeing these records.

tickets.subject: Search not returning results for tasks with specific custom field values
tickets.body: Hi, we've noticed that when we try to search for tasks using our custom "Project Phase" field in the search bar, it's not returning any results even though we know those tasks exist and have that field populated. The search works fine for task names and descriptions but seems to break specifically when filtering by custom fields. We have 12 seats on the Professional plan and this is blocking our team's workflow for at least half our daily searches. Can you take a look at whether this is a known issue or if there's something misconfigured on our end?

tickets.subject: 2FA codes not working - users locked out of workspace since 8am
tickets.body: We have 12 seats on the enterprise plan and our entire team has been unable to log in since this morning because the two-factor authentication is rejecting valid codes from Google Authenticator, we're losing about $200/hour in productivity and this is completely blocking our work. The 2FA requirement was already enforced on our workspace so now nobody can get in, we've tried re-adding authenticators and generating new codes but nothing works. We need this fixed immediately and expect a credit for today's downtime, our invoice is INV-447829 for reference.

tickets.subject: Jira sync charges keep showing up but we're not using it anymore
tickets.body: Hi, we have 12 seats on your platform and we turned off the Jira integration last month but we're still being charged $588 for the sync add-on on our last invoice. Our team needs this resolved today because we can't process our expenses report until we understand what's actually on our bill and stop being charged for features we disabled, can you either remove this charge or tell me if we need to do something different to actually deactivate it.

tickets.subject: question about upgrading to see gantt charts
tickets.body: hi, we're currently on the starter plan with 8 seats and one of our project managers mentioned that gantt view is only available on the professional tier. can you send me a quote for upgrading our whole account to professional so I can see what that would cost monthly, also do we need to upgrade all 8 seats or can we do like 3-4 seats on professional and keep the rest on starter

tickets.subject: Need to add custom fields but hit some kind of limit??
tickets.body: We just signed up for the Professional plan last month and were told we'd get unlimited custom fields but now when I try to add more than 15 fields to our project template it won't let me, we have 8 seats active right now and literally cannot run our intake process without at least 30 fields this is completely blocking us from using the tool for our client work today, is this a bug or do we need to upgrade to Enterprise or something because your pricing page isn't clear on this at all

tickets.subject: Why am I being charged for 50 seats when we only have 12 people??
tickets.body: This is ridiculous - we got our invoice today and you're charging us for 50 seats but we literally only have 12 employees using this, I checked the admin panel and it clearly shows 12 active users so why are you billing us for the extra 38 seats every single month, we cant work on our projects because I'm spending all my time dealing with billing issues instead of actually using your platform, this needs to be fixed immediately because our CFO is losing his mind over these charges, how do I fix this automatic billing so we only pay for what we're actually using?

tickets.subject: annual renewal invoice charged twice - system error
tickets.body: We got hit with TWO charges for our annual renewal yesterday, one for $5,880 (120 seats) and then another identical charge a few hours later, both went through on our payment method and now our accounting is completely confused. I know this is a billing thing but this is clearly a system glitch on your end - the renewal page must have double-processed our order or something. We need to figure out what happened here because we're not paying twice for the same year obviously.

tickets.subject: Need to add 3 more seats urgently - Jira sync is critical for our workflow
tickets.body: Hi, we've got 5 seats right now but our dev team just expanded and we need 8 total to get everyone synced up with Jira. We're trying to push a release today and right now half the team can't see project updates in real time because we're out of seats, it's blocking our whole sprint. Can you let me know the pricing for upgrading to 8 seats and if there's a pro-rata adjustment to our current invoice since we're mid-cycle, we need this set up in the next couple hours ideally.

tickets.subject: need to remove a contractor from our workspace
tickets.body: Hi, one of our contractors finished their project last week and I need to get them off our account since we're paying per seat. They still have access to everything and I'm not sure if we're still being charged for their spot - can you walk me through how to remove them or just do it for us? Their account name is john.dev@contractormail.com and they were added back in February. Thanks

tickets.subject: question about audit log feature in our plan
tickets.body: Hi, we're looking at moving our company over to your platform and I wanted to confirm which plan includes the full audit log with 90-day retention before we commit to 15 seats. We've got some compliance requirements around activity tracking so this feature is pretty important for our decision, can you let me know which tier has this and if it changes the pricing per user? Our current vendor charges extra for audit logs so I want to make sure I'm getting the right quote.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for March billing cycle - need this reversed immediately
tickets.body: We were billed $1,470 on March 1st for our 30 seats but then got charged again on March 15th for the exact same amount, our accounting team just caught it during month-end close and we need the duplicate charge reversed ASAP since it's throwing off our books. Looking at invoice #INV-89234 and #INV-89401, both are dated within two weeks of each other for the same period and same seat count. Can you process a credit back to our card on file for the second charge, this is holding up our reconciliation.

tickets.subject: Why am I being charged for 15 seats when we only use 5??
tickets.body: We switched to your platform 2 months ago and set up the Slack integration so our whole team gets notifications, but I just realized we're being billed for 15 active seats when literally only 5 people use this tool daily. The integration keeps auto-adding people to the seat count and I have no idea how to remove them without breaking everything. Our invoice is coming up and I'm losing my mind trying to figure out if we need to downgrade our plan or if this is a billing bug on your end. We're hemorrhaging money on unused seats and I need to know right now if we can adjust this before the next billing cycle hits.

tickets.subject: Recurring charges not stopping after cancellation
tickets.body: We cancelled our subscription on Nov 15th but our credit card was still charged on Dec 1st for all 12 seats, and we're getting charged again today for the third time. According to your documentation the recurring billing should stop immediately upon cancellation. This is blocking us from being able to process our own billing reconciliation and our finance team can't close out November. Can you stop these charges and tell me what's happening with our billing integration?

tickets.subject: Stop sending me billing emails to old domain
tickets.body: Hi, we switched email providers last month and my old domain is being forwarded but I'm getting duplicate invoice notifications to both addresses now. Can you update the email on our billing contact so I just get one copy? We have 12 seats on the annual plan.

tickets.subject: Calendar sync not working - recurring tasks not showing up on Google Calendar since yesterday morning
tickets.body: Hi, we've had our team synced to Google Calendar for the past 6 months and it's been working fine but as of yesterday around 10am none of our recurring tasks are showing up anymore on anyone's calendar even though they're clearly in the app. One-off tasks sync fine which is weird. We have 12 seats on the annual plan and this is breaking our workflow pretty bad, we'd like a credit applied to our account for at least this month while we figure out if we need to switch tools, we can't really operate like this. Can you look into what happened with the Google integration?

tickets.subject: Why am I being charged for 15 seats when we only use 5???
tickets.body: This is absolutely ridiculous, we've had the same 5 person team for months now but our invoice keeps showing we're paying for 15 seats, I don't know if this is a system error or what but nobody from your support has explained why our bill keeps going up every month when nothing has changed on our end. We're not even using those extra licenses. Can someone PLEASE look into our account and tell me what's going on with our subscription because this makes no sense.

tickets.subject: Search function completely broken - cant find any tasks
tickets.body: We've been trying to search for tasks all morning and nothing is working, the search bar just returns blank results every time even though we know the tasks exist. I've tried searching by task name, by assignee, by project - literally nothing works and we're dead in the water right now because our team can't locate anything. We have 12 seats on the Premium plan and this is making it impossible for us to do our jobs today. This worked fine yesterday so something broke on your end.

tickets.subject: Overcharged for seats in March billing cycle
tickets.body: Hi, we got charged for 15 seats on March 1st but we only had 12 active users that month, I removed 3 seats on March 5th after realizing the overage. Can you credit back the difference for those 3 unused seats? Our invoice shows $735 but it should be around $588. Thanks.

tickets.subject: Gantt chart not syncing with task updates - need credit for lost time
tickets.body: We've been having an issue where changes made to task dates in the list view aren't showing up in the Gantt chart until we refresh the entire page, sometimes multiple times. This has been happening for 3 days now and our project managers are constantly having to go back and forth to verify timelines which is pretty frustrating. We're a 12-seat customer and honestly we'd like some credit applied to our next invoice since this is costing us time and the Gantt view is pretty much half of why we pay for the pro plan. Can you look into what's causing the sync issue?

tickets.subject: Need to restrict custom fields access for certain roles immediately
tickets.body: Hi, we just realized that all our contributors can see and edit custom fields we set up for executive reporting only, including salary bands and confidential project codes. We have 23 seats and this is a serious data security issue for us. Can you walk me through how to configure field-level permissions by role or if this isn't possible in our current setup we need to know asap since we're running a board meeting tomorrow morning where these dashboards will be shared.

tickets.subject: Annual renewal went through but we're locked out of the workspace
tickets.body: Hi, our annual plan renewed this morning for 25 seats but now when our team tries to log in we're getting permission errors on everything, nobody can access projects or docs. The renewal confirmation says it went through and we're being charged but the workspace shows we have 0 active users. This is blocking our entire sprint planning for today. Invoice #INV-2024-8847 if that helps, can someone check our account permissions immediately?

tickets.subject: Question about custom field limits on our current plan
tickets.body: Hi, we're on the Professional plan with 12 seats at $49/seat and I wanted to check if there are additional charges if we need more than the standard custom fields included. We've got about 8 custom fields already but our product team keeps asking for more and I want to make sure we're not going to hit some kind of overage fee or if we need to upgrade to Enterprise to get unlimited custom fields, thanks.

tickets.subject: WHY AM I BEING CHARGED FOR 15 SEATS WHEN WE ONLY HAVE 8 PEOPLE
tickets.body: This is ridiculous, my renewal invoice just came through for $8,820 for 15 seats but we've only ever had 8 people on our workspace, I'm looking at the Members page right now and it clearly shows 8 active users so why in the world are we being billed for nearly double, we need this fixed before the renewal goes through next week because someone on our team must have accidentally added ghost accounts or something and I want to know exactly who did what and how to clean this up so we're not overpaying.

tickets.subject: We need a refund for last month - seats were provisioned to wrong users
tickets.body: Hi, we discovered that our former contractor still had active access to our workspace for the entire month of April and was able to view all our project data, we only realized this when we checked the audit log today and saw their name in there multiple times. We were charged for 12 seats that month but 1 of them shouldn't have been active at all since they left on March 31st. Can you issue a credit for that seat for April ($49) and also confirm you can permanently remove their access so this doesn't happen again, we need this resolved today since we're concerned about what data they may have accessed.

tickets.subject: Recurring billing stopped processing on our account
tickets.body: Hi, we have 12 seats on the annual plan and our card was supposed to be charged on the 15th each month but this month nothing went through and we're getting errors when trying to access the billing portal - it just shows a 500 error every time we click into it. Our team can't manage seat allocation or see our invoice history right now and I'm not sure if the next billing cycle will even go through or if we're going to lose access. Can you check what's happening with our account?

tickets.subject: Need to add more seats before EOD - current plan is full
tickets.body: Hi we're onboarding 3 new project managers today and they need access to the workspace but were told we've hit our seat limit on the current plan. How quickly can we upgrade from 10 to 15 seats? Also do we get prorated billing for the remainder of the month or is it calculated differently since we're mid-cycle with invoice #INV-4521? Need this sorted ASAP so the team can actually start working.

tickets.subject: We need MORE SEATS immediately - 2FA setup is broken and blocking our entire account access
tickets.body: This is ridiculous. We just added 3 new team members to our account yesterday and tried to enable 2FA for security before they start working, but now NONE of us can log in - the 2FA setup keeps failing and we're completely locked out. We're currently on the 5-seat plan but obviously need to upgrade anyway, so can someone PLEASE help us get access back and tell us the pricing for 12 seats instead because this is costing us hours of lost productivity and we have a deadline today.

tickets.subject: Can't find user in our workspace permissions section
tickets.body: Hi, we recently added 5 new seats to our workspace but one of our team members isn't showing up when I search for them in the permissions settings to assign them roles. I've tried searching by first name, last name, and email address but nothing comes up. They're able to log in fine and they're definitely in our org, so I'm not sure whats going on. This is blocking us from getting them set up with the right access levels. Can you help me figure out why the search isn't finding this user?

tickets.subject: 2FA requirement blocking our user onboarding - need to upgrade plan before we lose the client deal
tickets.body: Hi, we're trying to onboard a new client today who requires 2FA on all user accounts for compliance, but I just realized our current $49/seat plan doesn't include that feature - it's only available on the Enterprise tier. We have about 40 seats we need to provision and their contract starts tomorrow so we're pretty tight on time. Can we jump to a plan that has 2FA included and what would that cost us for the remaining 9 months of our fiscal year, we'd need the invoicing ASAP so we can get this approved.

tickets.subject: Question about file storage limits on the Professional plan
tickets.body: Hi, we're currently on the starter plan with 5 seats at $49/seat and I'm trying to figure out if we can keep using the same plan or if we need to upgrade. Our team has been attaching a lot of PDFs and documents to projects and I'm not sure what the storage limits are for each tier, can you send me the pricing breakdown so I can see what we'd be paying if we went to Professional? Just want to know the numbers before I approve it with accounting.

tickets.subject: URGENT: We need more seats immediately - Gantt view not loading for half our team
tickets.body: We're on the Professional plan with 15 seats but our project keeps getting held up because the Gantt view crashes whenever more than 8 people try to access it at the same time, so now half the team can't see the timeline and we're completely stuck waiting to finish this client deliverable. Do we need to upgrade to the Enterprise plan to get this fixed or can we just buy 10 more seats at $49/month? We need this sorted TODAY because we're losing time and I'm honestly frustrated that this is even a problem in the first place.

tickets.subject: Multiple team members can access accounts that should be restricted
tickets.body: We just realized that two former employees still have active login access to our workspace and have been able to view client project files through their old accounts, we have 8 seats total on our plan and we're not sure how long this has been happening. Can you immediately revoke their access and let us know if there's a way to see their login history? We're in compliance audits right now so this is pretty critical.

tickets.subject: Charge for time tracking feature we're not using
tickets.body: Hi, we were charged $245 last month for 5 seats but we only used the project management suite and never enabled the time tracking module. I know it's included but we're not utilizing it and frankly don't plan to, so I'm wondering if we can get that portion of the charge reversed or applied as a credit toward next month since we're essentially paying for something we don't need.

tickets.subject: Need to disable webhooks for departed team member - charging extra seats
tickets.body: Hi, we had an employee leave last week and I removed their account from the workspace but their old webhook URL is still firing events to their personal email server which we're now being billed for since the webhook integrations use API calls, is this considered a seat charge? We've been charged for 12 seats this month but only have 8 people and I need to get that credit applied before the next billing cycle, we can't proceed with any projects until this is sorted because the webhook config is tied to permissions and I can't find where to actually delete or disable the old endpoints.

tickets.subject: We're being charged for 15 guest accounts we can't remove - FIX THIS NOW
tickets.body: I don't understand why we keep getting billed for guest access seats every month when we disabled it weeks ago, our workspace settings show guests are turned off but the invoices still show 15 seats we're not even using and losing money on this and I need this reversed immediately and our credit card charged back before end of day - this is ridiculous we've asked twice already and nobody fixed it, what is going on??

tickets.subject: Question about Gantt view and whether we need more seats
tickets.body: Hi, we're currently on the 5-person plan and have been testing out the Gantt view feature for our construction projects. It looks great but I'm wondering if we should upgrade to a larger plan since it seems like the Gantt might be limited to certain plan tiers? Also trying to figure out if we need to add 2 more seats or if we can make do with the current setup and just do a different workflow. Can you clarify what's included in each plan when it comes to Gantt charts, and maybe send over pricing for the 10-seat tier so I can run it by my team.

tickets.subject: API webhooks not firing for task updates in production
tickets.body: Hi, we're integrating your API into our internal workflow automation and the task.updated webhooks stopped firing sometime last night around 11pm UTC. We're still able to query tasks directly through GET endpoints so the API itself seems up, but our automation is basically dead in the water without the webhooks. We have 12 seats and this is blocking our team's daily sync process. Can someone check if there's an issue on your end or if we need to reconfigure something? We're on the standard plan and this needs to get working today if possible.

tickets.subject: Custom fields disappeared from all projects - we need our money back for this month
tickets.body: We've been using your platform for 3 months now and had set up custom fields for all our active projects to track our internal workflow, but this morning every single one of them just vanished without warning. We have 12 seats on the $49 plan and paid for the full month already. The fields are completely gone - not hidden, not archived, just gone - and we have no idea what happened or how to get them back. Your documentation says custom fields should persist in projects but clearly that's not what's happening here, this is completely unacceptable and I want a credit for this month since we can't even use the tool properly right now. Can someone actually look into why this happened instead of sending me generic troubleshooting steps?

tickets.subject: Do we need additional licenses for sprint reports feature?
tickets.body: Hi, we're looking at rolling out sprint reports across our engineering dept and want to understand how many seats that would require. Currently we have 12 seats on the Professional plan, but I'm not sure if sprint reports require a higher tier or if each person generating reports needs their own license. Can someone clarify the pricing on this before we make the purchase? We're not in a rush, just want to budget this correctly for next quarter.

tickets.subject: why am I being charged for guest users when I only need 3 team members??? this is ridiculous
tickets.body: I've been using your platform for 2 months and just realized I'm being charged $49 per seat even though half my seats are just guests who barely use it, we only actually have 3 people using it regularly but apparently all these guest accounts are costing me a fortune and I don't even understand why guest access would cost the same as full seats when they can't even do half the stuff regular users can do, can you guys just explain your guest pricing or do I need to downgrade my plan because this seems like a huge ripoff and I'm seriously considering switching to something cheaper

tickets.subject: need to add 3 more seats before end of day - urgent
tickets.body: Hi, we just realized our current plan only covers 12 seats but we have 15 people who need access starting today for a client project that started this morning. I'm not getting the email notifications about seat usage so I didn't catch this sooner. Can you let me know the cost to upgrade to 15 seats and if you can process it immediately? We're bleeding money on this project without everyone having access.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for Jira sync add-on this month
tickets.body: Hi, we got billed $147 for the Jira sync integration twice on our invoice dated March 15th and March 15th again (looks like a duplicate charge). We're on the 6-seat plan at $49/seat so we should only see one charge. Can you credit back the extra $147 to our account, we can look at the invoice details if needed.

tickets.subject: Mobile app charges on my card but desktop isnt
tickets.body: Hi, I noticed we're getting charged for 12 seats on our monthly invoice but when I check the mobile app I only see 8 active users, the desktop version shows the same 8 but somehow the billing still reflects 12 and I'm not sure if theres a sync issue or if we're just being charged for unused seats, can someone clarify whats going on with the seat count vs what were actually paying for?

tickets.subject: Need clarification on audit log retention in our current plan before we add 15 more seats
tickets.body: Hi, we're looking to expand our team from 8 to 23 users but I need to confirm something first - our compliance officer just asked me how long audit logs are retained on the Professional plan ($49/seat) and whether that changes if we upgrade to Enterprise. We need 90 days minimum for our SOC 2 audit coming up in 3 weeks so I want to make sure before I submit the purchase order for the additional seats.

tickets.subject: STOP CHARGING ME FOR 15 SEATS WHEN I ONLY HAVE 3 PEOPLE - FIX THIS NOW
tickets.body: We've been overcharged for the last 3 months because your system keeps charging us for 15 active seats but we literally only have 3 employees using this thing.
